description: Khaled's Coordinator agent: twice-weekly half-week planning from the shared Supabase ledger and his activities, booked on the Coordinator calendar.

plugins.name: coordinator
plugins.description: Plans each half-week (Sun and Wed evening) as blocks of time that fit real places and real days: commitments first, travel, meals, buffers and 90-minute focus blocks, shown as a visual timeline. Nothing is booked until Khaled says "book it".
